relationships.subject: des-Arg10-kallidin
relationships.evidence_quote: Des-Arg<sup>10</sup>-kallidin, the carboxy-terminal des-Arg metabolite of kallidin, and bradykinin selectively activate two G protein-coupled receptors, type 1 and type 2 bradykinin receptors (B1R and B2R), respectively.

relationships.subject: bradykinin
relationships.evidence_quote: Des-Arg<sup>10</sup>-kallidin, the carboxy-terminal des-Arg metabolite of kallidin, and bradykinin selectively activate two G protein-coupled receptors, type 1 and type 2 bradykinin receptors (B1R and B2R), respectively.

key_findings: Cryo-EM structures of human B1R and B2R bound to des-Arg10-kallidin and bradykinin reveal the basis of ligand selectivity and activation.
